name: After § 83
title: REPORT on human rights and democracy in the world and the European Union’s policy on the matter – annual report 2025
part_text: 9b. Reiterates its condemnation of the fundamentalist regime in Iran and its restrictions of the fundamental freedoms of women and girls; underlines that gender-based segregation and exclusion from public life, education, employment, and political participation constitute a grave violation of international human rights law and may amount to crimes against humanity; calls for the EU to address such cases explicitly in its external action, human rights dialogues and multilateral engagements, and to support efforts towards accountability and justice for affected women and girls;
